title: Check hosted artifact bytes
responsibility: Checks a hosted capture’s supported media type, size and expected hash before returning it.

inputs.name: hostedArtifact.media
inputs.description: The hosted artifact bytes and server-declared media type used to choose the capture kind. The base type is trimmed, lowercased and stripped of parameters before matching image/png, image/jpeg, audio/wav, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, application/json or text/plain; its bytes must pass the corresponding content check, match the requested SHA-256 and stay at or below 11 MiB.

inputs.name: hostedArtifact.sha256
inputs.description: The expected lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the requested bytes, compared exactly with the digest computed from the stored bytes. A mismatch rejects the artifact.

outputs.name: hostedArtifact
outputs.description: The resolved result has exactly bytes, mediaType and sha256: the verified stored bytes, the media type inferred from their contents and the digest that passed comparison. It is returned only after kind-specific content checks and the 11 MiB limit; valid JSON declared as application/json stays application/json, while supported text may be served as text/plain; charset=utf-8.

errors.name: Hosted artifact type, integrity, or size failure
errors.description: Unsupported base media types, content that cannot be served under the declared type (including invalid UTF-8 or invalid JSON declared as JSON), SHA-256 mismatches and artifacts over 11 MiB reject the promise. Digest failures use the recorded-file message, oversize failures preserve the size error, and other content/type failures use the unsupported-kind message.
